newsitem.title: USA: Wilmington Trust silver stocks 58.7 mln ounces.
newsitem.headline: Wilmington Trust silver stocks 58.7 mln ounces.

text.p: Wilmington Trust deliverable silver stocks fell 630,350 ounces to 58,782,969 ounces as of Oct 7, said COMEX division of NYME.
Wilmington Trust in Delaware becomes an official exchange silver depository from Jan 1, 1997.
COMEX silver warehouse stocks, excluding Wilmington Trust silver stocks, stood at 137,631,324 ounces Tuesday.
NYMEX will report Wilmington Trust data weekly until Jan 2, when Wilmington's eligible and registered silver stocks will be included in the exchange's daily metal warehouse data.
